title: Vantia Artifact Envelope
description: Universal envelope for every Vantia pipeline artifact (task 1.1). NOTE: the v3.0 spec was not available to the builder; this is a v1 design and may need revision when v3.0 is supplied.

task_id.description: Vantia task id that produced this artifact (e.g. '2.7').

run_id.description: Vantia run number that produced this artifact.

user_id.description: Supabase auth user id (v4.0 R34). Empty when anonymous.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id for RLS isolation (v4.0 R35). Empty when anonymous.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous record in the run chain.

payload.description: Artifact body. Validated against the artifact-specific schema.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues raised during generation (schema violations, truncation, etc.).
